About Us

Cumbuco Rentals is a subsidiary of Fortaleza Real Estate in Fortaleza Brazil. Founded in 2003 by Ana Ceres Teixeira, Cumbuco Rentals was developed to offer high quality rentals for our customers. Cumbuco Rentals offers beach apartments and villas for rent in Cumbuco.

Ana has a background as a nurse and legally graduated as real estate agent in Fortaleza with CRECI 5653. CRECI = Conselho Regional de Corretores de Imóveis.
